LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO ENTREPRENEURSHIP

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.1: Introduction to Entrepreneurship

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Introduction to Entrepreneurship. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Introduction to Entrepreneurship
2. Practise Introduction to Entrepreneurship at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Introduction to Entrepreneurship

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Introduction to Entrepreneurship
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Introduction to Entrepreneurship. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Introduction to Entrepreneurship at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Introduction to Entrepreneurship at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Introduction to Entrepreneurship
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Introduction to Entrepreneurship. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Introduction to Entrepreneurship using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Introduction to Entrepreneurship in the examples.
2. Explain Introduction to Entrepreneurship to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Introduction to Entrepreneurship.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Introduction to Entrepreneurship using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Introduction to Entrepreneurship important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Introduction to Entrepreneurship
2. Practise Introduction to Entrepreneurship at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Introduction to Entrepreneurship

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
